procedure_column: Misra+etal2014 | Thermo Element XR | Univ Cambridge

Laboratory.cell: Godwin Laboratory for Palaeoclimate Research, University of Cambridge (affiliation)
Laboratory.value: Godwin Laboratory for Palaeoclimate Research, University of Cambridge (affiliation)

Target Material.cell: Foraminifera calcite (benthic and planktonic species; stated abstract)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Dissolved foraminiferal test aliquot -- "capable of analyzing small masses of calcite (5-10 mg), including single foraminifera specimens"; "Leached samples were dissolved in a minimum volume of 1 M HNO3 (40-60 uL) ... centrifuged for 2 min at 10,000 rpm and the supernatant was used for Me/Ca analysis. A 5 uL aliquot ..."
Sampling Unit Type.value: Dissolved foraminiferal test aliquot -- "capable of analyzing small masses of calcite (5-10 mg), including single foraminifera specimens"; "Leached samples were dissolved in a minimum volume of 1 M HNO3 (40-60 uL) ... centrifuged for 2 min at 10,000 rpm and the supernatant was used for Me/Ca analysis. A 5 uL aliquot ..."

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Handpicked 1–2 mg of species- and size-specific shells, cracked, clay removed (MQ water, methanol), reductively and/or oxidatively cleaned, leached in 0.001 M HNO3, dissolved in 1 M HNO3 and centrifuged; 5 µL of supernatant diluted with 200 µL 0.1 M HNO3 as the Me/Ca stock, Ca measured by ICP-AES, then diluted to [Ca] 10 ppm with 0.1 M HNO3 + 0.3 M HF — §2.4; the HF-bearing matrix 'was used only in the final dilution step'
Sample Preparation Method.value: Handpicked 1–2 mg of species- and size-specific shells, cracked, clay removed (MQ water, methanol), reductively and/or oxidatively cleaned, leached in 0.001 M HNO3, dissolved in 1 M HNO3 and centrifuged; 5 µL of supernatant diluted with 200 µL 0.1 M HNO3 as the Me/Ca stock, Ca measured by ICP-AES, then diluted to [Ca] 10 ppm with 0.1 M HNO3 + 0.3 M HF

Digestion Step.cell: dissolution (minimum volume of 1 M HNO3, 40–60 µL, then centrifuged 2 min at 10,000 rpm) — §2.4

Final Solution Matrix.cell: all: 0.1 M HNO3 + 0.3 M HF — 'The acid matrix containing HF was used only in the final dilution step'

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: Thermo Fisher Scientific -- "a Thermo Element XR, a single collector sector field high resolution inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"
Instrument Manufacturer.value: Thermo Fisher Scientific -- "a Thermo Element XR, a single collector sector field high resolution inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"

Instrument Model.cell: Thermo Element XR single-collector SF-ICP-MS (stated section 2.3)
Instrument Model.value: Thermo Element XR single-collector SF-ICP-MS (stated section 2.3)

Mass Resolution Setting.cell: LR and MR (stated Table 1 and section 2.3)
Mass Resolution Setting.value: LR and MR (stated Table 1 and section 2.3)

Detector Configuration.cell: Dual mode, fixed for each isotope: counting for 7Li, 11B, 111Cd, 137Ba, 238U, 55Mn, 56Fe, 66Zn and analog for 25Mg, 27Al, 43Ca, 87Sr, 23Na — Tables 1 and 3; 'measured at a fixed detection mode to avoid detection mode switch (pulse to analog) during analysis' (§2.3.1)
Detector Configuration.value: Dual mode, fixed for each isotope: counting for 7Li, 11B, 111Cd, 137Ba, 238U, 55Mn, 56Fe, 66Zn and analog for 25Mg, 27Al, 43Ca, 87Sr, 23Na

Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.cell: Teflon Scott-type single-pass (Savillex PFA; Table 1 footnote)
Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.value: Teflon Scott-type single-pass (Savillex PFA; Table 1 footnote)

Sample Uptake Rate.cell: 50 uL ESI nebulizer; uptake time 70 s (Table 1); volumetric flow rate N
Sample Uptake Rate.value: 50 uL ESI nebulizer; uptake time 70 s (Table 1); volumetric flow rate N

Analytical Mode.cell: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- "a Teflon Scott type (single pass) spray chamber was constructed"; "we used a platinum injector (1.8 mm I.D.)"; ESI nebulizer
Analytical Mode.value: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- "a Teflon Scott type (single pass) spray chamber was constructed"; "we used a platinum injector (1.8 mm I.D.)"; ESI nebulizer

ICP Tuning.cell: "Instrumental sensitivity was optimized on 11B, 115In, and 175Lu", with sensitivities "set as operational criteria"; "in medium resolution tuning, the instrument was optimized on 56Fe to achieve a mass resolution"
ICP Tuning.value: "Instrumental sensitivity was optimized on 11B, 115In, and 175Lu", with sensitivities "set as operational criteria"; "in medium resolution tuning, the instrument was optimized on 56Fe to achieve a mass resolution"

Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Li.cell: Partially -- "The instrument was conditioned with a 10 [ppb solution]" before analysis, and detector mode was "kept fixed through the entire run to avoid detection mode switch induced changes in sensitivity". No warm-up time or session duration limit stated
Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Li.value: Partially -- "The instrument was conditioned with a 10 [ppb solution]" before analysis, and detector mode was "kept fixed through the entire run to avoid detection mode switch induced changes in sensitivity". No warm-up time or session duration limit stated

Target Species.cell: Li, B, Na, Mg, Al, Mn, Fe, Zn, Sr, Cd, Ba, U — 'The concentrations of foraminiferal trace elements of interest (Li, B, Na, Mg, Al, Mn, Fe, Zn, Sr, Cd, Ba, and U)' (§2.3.1); Ca is the ratio denominator

Reported Variables and Units.cell: B/Ca (µmol/mol); Li/Ca, Mg/Ca, Al/Ca, Sr/Ca, Cd/Ca, Ba/Ca, U/Ca, Na/Ca, Mn/Ca, Fe/Ca, Zn/Ca (µmol/mol or mmol/mol) — Me/Ca ratios; Li, Mg, Al, Sr, Cd, Ba and U in low resolution, Na, Mn, Fe and Zn in medium (Table 3)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 7Li → Li; 11B → B; 25Mg → Mg; 27Al → Al; 43Ca → none; 87Sr → Sr; 111Cd → Cd; 137Ba → Ba; 238U → U; 23Na → Na; 55Mn → Mn; 56Fe → Fe; 66Zn → Zn — Table 3; ⁴³Ca is measured in both resolutions

Mass Resolution Assignment.cell: LR: low resolution (Δm/m = 300), for 7Li, 11B, 25Mg, 27Al, 43Ca, 87Sr, 111Cd, 137Ba, 238U; MR: medium resolution (Δm/m = 4000), for 23Na, 43Ca, 55Mn, 56Fe, 66Zn — Table 3

Number of Scans per Replicate.cell: LR: 15 passes × 3 runs; MR: 5 passes × 3 runs — Table 3; Table 1 prints 3 passes for MR

Analysis Sequence.cell: Blocks of seven samples, each bracketed by a pair of acid blanks and internal consistency standards (Standard 3 of the calibration) — §2.3.1
Analysis Sequence.value: Blocks of seven samples, each bracketed by a pair of acid blanks and internal consistency standards (Standard 3 of the calibration)

Internal Standard Element.cell: all: none — Me/Ca ratios, with Ca measured in both resolutions

Oxide Production Method and Threshold.cell: Sensitivity criteria used (not oxide threshold): >=250000 cps/ppb for 11B; >=2500000 for 115In; >=2000000 for 175Lu (stated section 2.3.1)
Oxide Production Method and Threshold.value: Sensitivity criteria used (not oxide threshold): >=250000 cps/ppb for 11B; >=2500000 for 115In; >=2000000 for 175Lu (stated section 2.3.1)

Acquisition Pass.cell: LR; MR — low resolution (Δm/m = 300) and medium resolution (Δm/m = 4000) methods, 'Calcium was measured in both low and medium resolution to maintain accuracy of Me/Ca ratios obtained from the two mass resolution modes' (Table 3)

Drift Correction Method.cell: N — the blocks of seven are bracketed by acid blanks and a consistency standard; at low calcium concentrations there was 'minimal instrumental sensitivity drift' (§2.3.1)

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: all: external calibration with matrix-matched standards, samples and standards concentration-matched within ±5% — ±1% in the Fig. 2 dilution series; at [Ca] of 10 ppm with normal cones, 5 ppm with the Jet and X cones; samples first measured for Ca by ICP-AES (§2.3.1)

value.value: external calibration with matrix-matched standards, samples and standards concentration-matched within ±5%

Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Corre.cell: all: detector cross-calibration between pulse and analog modes performed daily — §2.3.1

value.value: detector cross-calibration between pulse and analog modes performed daily

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: N — Na, Mn, Fe and Zn are measured in medium resolution (Table 3); no correction is described

Interfering Species.cell: N — MR resolution used to resolve polyatomic interferences; no additional mathematical correction reported; stated section 2.3

Uncertainty Level.cell: 2 sigma -- "with 2r analytical uncertainty" and "the gray area represents the 2r spread in the B/Ca measured at 10 ppm [Ca]Matrix" (r = sigma in the extracted text)
Uncertainty Level.value: 2 sigma -- "with 2r analytical uncertainty" and "the gray area represents the 2r spread in the B/Ca measured at 10 ppm [Ca]Matrix" (r = sigma in the extracted text)

Calibration Factor and Determination Met.cell: N — 'Before sample analysis, mass bias determination was carried out using a foraminiferal matrix matched solution' (§2.3.1); no factor is stated

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially -- "Open symbols represent an average of 10 measurements acquired during a single instrument session. The solid symbols represent the average of the open symbols"; and for a second figure "which is a total of 15 measurements"; acquisition structured as 3 runs x 15 passes (low resolution) or 3 x 5 (medium). No acceptance or rejection rule stated
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Partially -- "Open symbols represent an average of 10 measurements acquired during a single instrument session. The solid symbols represent the average of the open symbols"; and for a second figure "which is a total of 15 measurements"; acquisition structured as 3 runs x 15 passes (low resolution) or 3 x 5 (medium). No acceptance or rejection rule stated

Combination Method.cell: all: average of 10 measurements within a session, and average of the session averages — 'Open symbols represent an average of 10 measurements acquired during a single instrument session. The solid symbols represent the average of the open symbols'

value.value: average of 10 measurements within a session, and average of the session averages

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Standard 3 brackets each block of seven samples — §2.3.1
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: Standard 3 brackets each block of seven samples

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: CAM-wuellerstorfi; CAM-Uvig-1; CAM-Uvig-2; CAM-Mix — the four Cambridge consistency standards (§2.2)

Detection Limit.cell: B/Ca: 2 µmol/mol; other: N — 'We report a B/Ca detection limit of 2 µmol/mol' (abstract)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: all [B/Ca: 4.0% (2σ), average within-run external precision] — abstract

Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical P.cell: CAM-wuellerstorfi, CAM-Uvig-1, CAM-Uvig-2, CAM-Mix [all: ±2σ of repeat analyses over 8 months] — Table 4; n = 180, 130, 100 and 150

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: CAM-wuellerstorfi, CAM-Uvig-1, CAM-Uvig-2, CAM-Mix [B/Ca: across degrees of sample dilution] — Fig. 2

Additional Notes.cell: Teflon Scott-type single-pass spray chamber and platinum injector (1.8 mm I.D.) to reduce instrumental boron blanks; HF in the final matrix for rapid boron washout (§2.3)
Additional Notes.value: Teflon Scott-type single-pass spray chamber and platinum injector (1.8 mm I.D.) to reduce instrumental boron blanks; HF in the final matrix for rapid boron washout (§2.3)
